name: Luminous Lantern School
description: A school of living lanterns drifts through the night sky, forming patterns and shapes that tell stories to those who watch from below.
prompt: Swarm of bioluminescent lanterns floating in night sky, forming letters and shapes, soft glow, city lights below, dreamy composition, hyperrealistic, no text, gentle movement, narrative atmosphere.
caption: Let the lantern school paint the night with stories—each floating light is a letter in the sky’s poem.
